content: Ne Pauli, natenga jwa Yecho Kilichitu kwa kupala Chapanga. Ninyandikila mangota mabhando bha Chapanga bhumii kwenio ku Epecho, bhinnyeketii njwe mu kulombana na Yecho Kilichitu.
Ninyope umbone na uteeke kuhumii kwa Chapanga Tate gwito na Bhambo Yecho Kilichitu.
Mota ya kihuke kwa kulombana na Kilichitu
Alombwe Chapanga, Tate jwa Bhambo gwito Yecho Kilichitu! Nhwalo kwa kulombana na Kilichitu atupekii mota yoha ya ki Uhuke mu nnema gwa kihuke.
Kabula jha kupanganwa kwa nnema, Chapanga akatuhagwii njwe twenga tubhehe bhake kwa kulombana na Kilichitu kupala tubhehe nyahinyahi na twanga malemo palonge jhake. Kwa nhwalo gwa mapalo ghake,
Chapanga akahamwii na kutuhaghuu tubhehe twakayana yake kwa ndela jha Yecho Kilichitu. Yene ndi chahalilwa na chapalita.
Ngohe tunombe Chapanga nhwalo jha umbone gwake gwamaha gwatupekii jhajhe kupete Mwana mundo jwampahile!
Nhwalo gwa miyahe jha Kilichitu, twenga tukombolilwe, yane uhakaho gwito ulekekekiwe. Yene ndi chibhii kwa ukolongwa gwa umbone gwake,
atupekii mbwe mwenio, kwa malango na kumanya kwake koha.
Chapanga atuyekulile chile jhijhihitwe jhapalita kuitenda. Akahalalichwe na ajhakutuhenge lende kwa ndela jha Yecho Kilichitu.
Gheniya ghoha pukipala kuhika kipinde chapangite Chapanga, Kilichitu naleta ilebhe yoha ya kunane kwa Chapanga na ya pannema pamonga na ilongochwe na jwenio.
Chapanga akatei yoha ngita chapalita, Chapanga akatuhagwii twenga kwa kulombana na Kilichitu, tubhehe bhando bhake ngita chapalita, akahamwii naha kuhumii makacho.
Chapanga akatehi yenio, twenga bhitulongolile kunhobholela Kilichitu tuulumbulile ung'alicho gwa Chapanga!

Na mangota helahela punombikina na Kilichitu pala punyohina lilobhe lya chakaka ndi Lilobhe lya Mbone lilinetii ukomboche, mukanyeketii Kilichitu, na jwenio Chapanga kwa kulangii mangota ndi bhando bhake, amekite unepo kwa kumpelengana Uhuke gwa Chapanga jwatulaghii.
Uhuke gwenio gwa Chapanga ndi poni jha kupata ghala ghoha gha bhando bhake, kilebhe chenje ndi kitulangii kubhehe Chapanga nabhakombola bhando bhake bhoha. Tulumbilile ung'alicho gwake!
Pauli innyopa Chapanga
Yene, kubhoke punyohina chimuhobholela Bhambo Yecho na chimwapala bhando bhoha bha Chapanga,
ngotwike jhe kunchenguu Chapanga kwa nhwalo gwino. Nanikombokangana mu kunnyopa kwango Chapanga,
nijhendele kunnyopa Tate jwa ung'alicho, Chapanga jwa Bhambo gwito Yecho Kilichitu, ampelengane Uhuke jwapala kuntenda mme na malango na kuyekulila mumanye Chapanga chamaha hake.
Ninyopa Chapanga haijhoghole miojho jhino mupokele lumule lwake, nhoto kulimanya lihobholelo lela lyankemile na ung'alicho nkolongwa gwa ghala lyabhabhekii bhando bhake,
na umanye likakala lyake chibhii likolongwa kwa twenga bhituhobholela. Likakala lyenio ndi lihenga lihengo nkate jhito lilandana na likakala lela likolongwa,
lyayokiche nako Kilichitu kuhumii kwa bhubhawile, ngamekita lubhoko lwalelo kwenio kunane kwa Chapanga.

Kwenio, Kilichitu ndi nkolongwa kuliku ilongoche yoha ya kunane kwa Chapanga na kila ukindendeke na kila likakala na akabhambo, na ilongocha ukindendeke ghoha gwa pannema ghongo na ghola ghupala kuhika.

Chapanga ampekii ukindendeke mu ilebhe yoha, ajhakumeka abhehe nkolongwa jwa makunde gha bhando bhibhanyeketii Kilichitu abhe nkolongwa kwa ilebhe yoha kwa nhwalo gwa bhando bhibhannyeketii Kilichitu.
Bhando bheniya ndi yegha jha Kilichitu, na bhando ndi ukamilicho gwa jwenie jwalenganikiya ilebhe yoha kila chehemo.
